emoji_ui_browser_verify.s:
VERIFY the whole emoji flow end-to-end in the live app with agent-browser, in BOTH the room chat and the DM chat, and fix anything that breaks. dev:all is already running: vite dev on http://localhost:7227, ws worker on :8787.

SETUP: agent-browser session already holds the logged-in x@t.com user (id 73db4f19-d50a-4e0f-8530-4a4067938a78, pw 549000).

VERIFY LIST:
1. Room chat (http://localhost:7227/app/rooms/<id>, e.g. 'bois n grls'): click composer 'emoji' button (aria-label 'emoji', lucide smile outline next to the 🙂 sticker button) -> a modal titled 'emoji' opens showing the NEW picker (search box autofocused, 'recent' row, grid-cols-12 grid, sticky group headers 'smileys & emotion' etc). Click an emoji -> modal closes, the emoji is spliced into the composer input at the cursor, input keeps focus. Click 'send message' (or Ctrl+Enter) -> message with the emoji appears in the thread (agent-browser snapshot should show the emoji in a message bubble).
2. Reaction picker in room: hover a message bubble, click 'react' -> same overhauled picker in a modal titled 'react'. Pick an emoji -> a reaction chip (emoji + count) appears under the message. Confirm the recent row now shows the emoji just picked.
3. DM chat (http://localhost:7227/app/chat/<peer>): repeat step 1 and 2 against the DM page (peer e7bb811d-4c81-4a23-8870-63d4ba299573, 1440fl).
4. Regression: sticker button still works (opens StickerPicker, sends a sticker); search box filters the emoji grid; Escape closes the picker modal.
5. Check the dev log (/tmp/opencode/x2-dev.log) after the run for SSR/compile/runtime errors.

On any failure (button missing, splice wrong, picker not rendering, chips not appearing): diagnose from the DOM (agent-browser snapshot -i, eval) and the dev log, fix the source, re-run. Do NOT mark done until all 5 checks pass.

PHASES: this is a verification step, not a code change — run the checks, fix only if something breaks, then done. After it passes: run the full gate one last time (pnpm test && pnpm check && pnpm lint), delete plan/emoji_ui.plan.json, and git push.
